proposal.expected_benefit: This update will improve the system's ability to detect and respond to real-world adversarial actions, reducing the risk of overconfidence and enhancing overall security posture.
proposal.problem: The system's current defense mechanism may overconfidently assume the absence of real-world adversarial actions due to reliance on simulation-only scenarios.
proposal.proposed_change: Integrate real-time threat intelligence feeds and dynamic risk assessment models to adapt to evolving attack vectors, ensuring the system remains effective against both known and emerging threats.
proposal.title: Enhance Real-Time Threat Intelligence Integration
verification_tests: Evaluate system performance against real-world adversarial scenarios
Assess integration of threat intelligence feeds with existing defense mechanisms
Measure impact on operational efficiency and false positive rates
